Markets.title: Capital market industry hopes for relief in capital gains taxation in Budget 2027-28: Axis Capital MD
Markets.summary: Axis Capital Managing Director Lakha Nair stated that the capital market industry expects relief in capital gains taxation in the upcoming Union Budget 2027-28. This anticipated relief includes a potential reduction in the short-term capital gains tax.

Markets.title: Nasdaq futures rise as investors return to battered AI stocks: Stock Market Live Updates
Markets.summary: Nasdaq futures rose as investors bought back into recently beaten-down artificial intelligence stocks. The market rebound follows a period of heavy losses in the technology sector.

Markets.title: India bonds slump as oil spike adds to RBI hike bets
Markets.summary: Indian government bonds fell this week as rising oil prices and U.S. Treasury yields pushed the benchmark bond yield to 7.2650% on Friday. This surge in oil prices has heightened inflation concerns, leading analysts to anticipate an interest rate hike in the Reserve Bank of India's upcoming policy decision.

Markets.title: Ion Exchange India among 6 stocks hitting 52-week low; shares slipped up to 20% in a month
Markets.summary: Amid broader market weakness, Ion Exchange India was one of six BSE 1000 stocks to hit fresh 52-week lows on Friday. Shares of these companies, which also include Dishman Carbogen Amcis, Happiest Minds, and TCI Express, slipped by up to 20% over the past month.

Markets.title: Eurozone bond yields rise as investors return to riskier assets, oil prices rebound
Markets.summary: Eurozone government bond yields increased as investors moved toward riskier assets and oil prices rebounded amid rising Middle East tensions. Markets also evaluated the European Central Bank's policy outlook while pricing in two 25-basis-point rate hikes by June 2027.

Markets.title: Rupee rally takes a hit as AI trade revival dents shares, currency sees weekly dip
Markets.summary: The Indian rupee fell against the US dollar this week due to declining local stocks and rising oil prices. Despite foreign investments in Indian equities reaching $16 billion this month, the rupee's stability remains threatened by a global revival in AI market interest.

Geo-Political.title: Zelensky criticises 'strange' Trump-Putin friendship in BBC interview
Geo-Political.summary: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky criticized Donald Trump for having a strange friendship with Vladimir Putin in a recent BBC interview. He also expressed frustration that the United States is not pushing Russia hard enough in peace negotiations to end the war.

Geo-Political.title: Hundreds of thousands still without power after storms hit US on Thanksgiving
Geo-Political.summary: Severe wind and rain storms struck both coasts of the United States on Thanksgiving, leaving hundreds of thousands of residents without power. Pennsylvania and neighboring states remain the hardest hit as power outages continue into Friday.

Geo-Political.title: Leaders clash in final Spain election debate as housing dominates run-in
Geo-Political.summary: Spanish political leaders clashed over the housing crisis during the final debate of a bitter election campaign. The difficulty of buying a home has emerged as the central issue for voters in this election.

Geo-Political.title: Italy's former police chief rejected mafia inquiry allegations before death
Geo-Political.summary: An eight-page letter by late former Italian police chief Gianni De Gennaro was revealed days after his body was found at his Tuscany home. In the letter, De Gennaro rejected allegations regarding a mafia inquiry.

Geo-Political.title: Ex-media executive admits saying Australian child sex abuse survivor 'looking to be raped again'
Geo-Political.summary: A former Murdoch media executive has admitted making a derogatory remark about Australian child sex abuse survivor Grace Tame's attire at an event. The executive was overheard stating that Tame was "looking to be raped again."

Geo-Political.title: Mushroom murderer Erin Patterson launches last-ditch High Court appeal
Geo-Political.summary: Erin Patterson is serving a life sentence for poisoning her relatives with a toxic mushroom lunch in 2023. She has now launched a final appeal in the High Court against her conviction.

Data & Insights.title: China Railway Resources Group bets on Zimbabwe's gold potential with AI mining and $600 million investment plan
Data & Insights.summary: China Railway Resources Group plans to invest $600 million to revive and expand four gold mines in Zimbabwe through a partnership with Duration Gold. The proposed project will introduce engineering expertise, financing, and AI-powered mining technology to the Vubachikwe and Gaika mines.

Data & Insights.title: RBI governor urges MSMEs to free-trade deals; flags low AI adoption
Data & Insights.summary: The RBI governor urged micro, small, and medium enterprises to leverage free-trade agreements to improve market access and integrate into global value chains. He also highlighted their low adoption of artificial intelligence as a key area of concern.

Data & Insights.title: US tariffs: India gets an edge over China, Vietnam, Bangladesh—but what must New Delhi do to secure it?
Data & Insights.summary: The US has proposed a 17 percent tariff on Indian exports if a trade deal is reached, potentially giving India an advantage over rival Asian nations. However, this offer requires India to meet specific demands regarding market access and trade policies through ongoing negotiations.

Data & Insights.title: South Korea raises rates to 2-year high as inflation and housing prices remain a worry
Data & Insights.summary: South Korea's central bank raised its benchmark interest rate by 25 basis points to 3.25 percent, reaching a two-year high. The increase was driven by concerns over inflation exceeding target levels and rising housing prices in Seoul.

Data & Insights.title: UAE eyes 7-8% growth next year as IMF reverses recession forecast, projects 0.2% expansion
Data & Insights.summary: The UAE economy minister targets 7% to 8% growth next year, while the IMF forecasts a 0.2% expansion. This projected recovery depends on the Iran war, with future investments prioritizing crisis-resilient industries.

Data & Insights.title: India’s Q2 GDP growth to slow marginally to 7.6%, shows Mint poll
Data & Insights.summary: India's Q2 GDP growth is expected to slow marginally to 7.6% according to a Mint poll. While resilient manufacturing and services supported the economy, a deficient monsoon and uneven rural demand weighed on growth.

India.title: Meta Says Instagram For TV To Be Released In India Soon
India.summary: Meta announced that Instagram for TV will soon be released in India. This new feature lets users watch content from their favorite creators on larger screens based on feedback that shared viewing is more enjoyable than watching alone on mobile phones.

India.title: "Will Support Delimitation Bill": Sharad Pawar's Party MP's Big Remark
India.summary: Sharad Pawar's party MP stated they will support the newly cleared delimitation-linked women's reservation bill. The Union Cabinet approved the legislation, which is expected to be introduced during the special parliamentary session starting next week.

India.title: Swiggy To Lay Off 340 Employees At Instamart Amid Restructuring: Report
India.summary: Swiggy is laying off 340 employees at its quick-commerce unit, Instamart, as part of a business restructuring. This job cut comes amid intense market competition with rivals Blinkit and Zepto to expand delivery networks and capture market share.

India.title: MK Stalin, Sharad Pawar's Parties Behind Delimitation Push? Karti Chidambaram Exclusive
India.summary: A delimitation bill packaged with three separate legislations failed to pass Parliament in August due to a lack of the required two-thirds majority. MK Stalin and Sharad Pawar's parties are reportedly behind the push for this delimitation, according to Karti Chidambaram.

India.title: Voter Rolls To Delimitation: Gyanesh Kumar Could Be Part Of Landmark Process To Redraw India's Poll Map
India.summary: Gyanesh Kumar may oversee the upcoming redrawing of India's electoral constituency boundaries. The Congress-led opposition fears this delimitation process will result in gerrymandering to favor one political party.

India.summary: This article excerpt examines how Indian actor Vijay leveraged two decades of film stardom to successfully transition into politics and win votes. It analyzes the strategies behind the making of his political persona, known as 'Thalapathy'.

General.summary: Catherine shares her personal experience with illness and recovery after a cancer diagnosis in a new documentary. The film features her thoughts on navigating what she describes as a lonely road.
